O.content: The line is almost horizontal from the 2021 position to the 2022 position and then ends slightly lower at 2023.
The x-axis is inscribed "Year" with ticks 2018 through 2023, and the y-axis is inscribed "Grid Output (GWh)".

B.text: For this routing task, if the overall dashboard pattern is treated as mixed or approximately stable, routine clean-grid output monitoring is the matching route. No explicit threshold defining "routine" versus decline or expansion is supplied.
B.conditions: Applies only if the workflow treats a recent near-flat pattern as routine despite an earlier or endpoint decline.

O.content: The title visibly reads "Increasing Clean Grid Output from 2018 to 2023".

B.text: If the dashboard title is treated as an authoritative statement of the overall output trend, the word "Increasing" supports the clean-grid output expansion follow-up route.
B.conditions: Applies only if the title is authoritative over the plotted line; this conflicts with the visible lower final plotted position.

O.content: The blue line begins at the 2018 tick aligned with the printed 2,800 y-axis tick and ends at the 2023 tick lower on the page.
The x-axis is inscribed "Year" with ticks 2018 through 2023, and the y-axis is inscribed "Grid Output (GWh)".

B.text: For this routing task, if the full review-window trend is classified by its lower final output relative to its initial output, the matching route is clean-grid output decline response review.
B.conditions: Applies if endpoint-to-endpoint direction is the governing definition of the overall trend; no alternative policy threshold is supplied.
